verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.clickup.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a ClickUp Documentation header). The developer docs are also served as .md pages, such as authentication.md and tasks.md, which an agent can ingest directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing llms.txt or agent-oriented doc usage (e.g., an llms-full.txt or guidance for agents), and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
